name: fatfish-pet
description: 大肥魚桌面寵物（WorkBuddy 版）：透過 Claude Code 相容 hook 感知 Agent 工作狀態（剛開工／工作中／等你按確認／完成收工／出錯），把狀態寫成狀態檔供寵物主機監看；並註冊 pet_say / pet_state 兩個 MCP 工具，讓 Agent 可以直接跟她說話。
description_en: Blue fatfish (whale girl) desktop pet for WorkBuddy. Maps Agent lifecycle hooks (thinking / working / waiting / success / error) into a state file the pet host watches, and exposes pet_say / pet_state MCP tools.
